name: Cool Days
source:
Senior girls, tattooed self titled rich asshole Corey, and a demonic painter get together after school to hunt spirits.

And to keep order on earth (but really, they mostly do it because what else is there to do in an semi abandoned small town). 

That is until they mess up and get swarmed by the angelic police.

[From [url=https://doibats.itch.io/cool-days]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
高年级女孩、纹身的自称富混蛋科里和恶魔画家放学后聚在一起狩猎灵魂。

为了维持地球上的秩序（但实际上，他们这样做主要是因为在一个半废弃的小镇上还有什么可做的）。

直到他们陷入混乱并被天使警察包围。

[来自[url=https://doibats.itch.io/cool-days]itch.io[/url]]
